title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental: Return Time and the Last Additional Rental Day
content:
**Ruling note on the last additional rental day of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.** The rental days started are the calendar days from the actual pickup date to the actual return date, plus one more when the actual return time is later than the actual pickup time. The last additional day is counted by the return time:

- when the vehicle came back within the rental days booked on the calendar day that last rental day began — that is, with an actual return time later than the actual pickup time — and no later than **12:00**, the last additional day counts as **0.5** of a day;
- when it came back on that day, within the rental days booked, after 12:00 and no later than **15:00**, it counts as **0.75** of a day;
- otherwise it counts as a whole day.

Every earlier additional day counts as a whole day.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical contract picked up Monday 09:00, scheduled return Thursday 09:00, rental days booked 3, two additional days)

| Checked in | Rental days started | Last additional day counts as | Additional days counted in all |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 11:30 | 3 | 0.5 | 1.5 |
| Wednesday 12:00 | 3 | 0.5 — no later than 12:00 | 1.5 |
| Wednesday 12:01 | 3 | 0.75 | 1.75 |
| Wednesday 15:00 | 3 | 0.75 — no later than 15:00 | 1.75 |
| Wednesday 15:01 | 3 | Whole | 2 |
| Thursday 08:30 | 3 | Whole — 08:30 is not later than the 09:00 pickup time, so the last rental day began on Wednesday | 2 |
| Thursday 10:00 | 4 — beyond the 3 booked | Whole — not within the rental days booked | 2 |

A contract picked up at 13:00 and checked in at 12:30 on a later day takes a whole last day, since 12:30 is not later than its pickup time.
